adjudication.rationale: In `packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx`, the remove button uses a hardcoded tooltip string: `<Tooltip content="Remove email">`, while other user-facing strings in the component/dialog are localized via `t()` (e.g., `{t("add_another")}`, labels passed from `{t("add_emails")}`). This creates an untranslated English tooltip for non-English locales.
